_comment: Cards and status checks for README.md. Every sentence and number comes from the project's README (checked 2026-11-25). Pictures are the projects' own, in assets/projects.

projects.line: The Go port of OrbitDB, the peer-to-peer database on IPFS, byte-for-byte compatible with the JavaScript version.
A blockchain network simulator, extended to measure how final a Bitcoin transaction is, including under attack.
projects.panel: How final is a Bitcoin transaction?

projects.line: An on-chain policy, not the prompt, decides what the agent can spend.
projects.fact: $0 lost in 110 attack runs; unguarded, $15,333 in 27 of 110.

projects.line: The same circuits on every build of PennyLane, Lightning and Catalyst, each change traced to its pull request.

projects.line: Lets any bot log in, answers with a convincing fake Ubuntu shell, and records everything it tries.

projects.line: Language models, scripted bots and you at one table, with replays, leagues and coaching.

projects.line: The planes you can see from your window, drawn where you would see them, from free flight-tracking feeds.
